g.text: Reference symbols stop where the scan resolves them.
Axisymmetric disk cavity: matched-sigma comparison with published numerical theory
Same Riabouchinsky image-disk closure; L/R solved for each σ. No experimental-validation claim.
Reference: Brennen (1969), p.680 Fig.3; scan bounds ±0.006 in r/R and ±0.012 in Cp are reading bounds.
